svg.title: Data Modelling in Microsoft Fabric — from business concept to semantic contract
svg.desc: A branching architecture diagram with nine nodes. It starts at a conceptual business model, moves to a logical model decision point that splits into dimensional (star/snowflake) and data-vault modelling techniques, then both feed a physical-layer choice between a Fabric Lakehouse and a Fabric Warehouse. Both physical options converge on a semantic model, which can run in Direct Lake mode for near-real-time queries without a separate import refresh. A ninth node, marked as a warning, calls out mixed-grain fact tables and Direct Lake fallback to DirectQuery as the two concrete failure modes that break this chain in production.
svg.text: Data vault (hub / link / satellite) — Auditable, insert-only structure for multi-source integration and history.Data Modelling in Microsoft Fabric

Conceptual business model — Bounded entities, grain, and ownership agreed before any Fabric item is created.Data Modelling in Microsoft Fabric architecture — Conceptual business model, Lakehouse or Warehouse physical model, Semantic model and consumption contract

text.title: Lakehouse physical layer — Delta tables on OneLake, Spark-first, handles unstructured data alongside structured tables.
Logical model: dimensional vs vault — The design technique decision point — star/snowflake vs data vault vs plain canonical.
Dimensional (star / snowflake) — Fact + conformed dimension tables optimised for BI query patterns.

svg.text: Mixed grain & fallback failures — The two concrete ways this modelling chain breaks: mixed-grain fact tables, and Direct Lake view-based fallback.⚠ Mixed grain
Semantic model (consumption contract) — The Analysis Services tabular model report authors actually query — Import, DirectQuery, or Direct Lake.⚠ Measures duplicated per report

Warehouse physical layer — Delta tables on OneLake, T-SQL-first, full multi-table ACID transactions.In Atlas: select a choice → inspect evidence → drill into inputs, processing, outputs, example, controls, and risks.
Direct Lake mode — Reads Parquet straight from OneLake without an Import-mode memory copy — two flavors with different security paths.Fabric Atlas original · Microsoft Fabric implementation guidance
